digest.component_or_area: src/rebar/llm — model capability system (Bedrock native structured output + extended thinking)
propositions: native_structured_output is currently blanket-disabled for all Claude via _REBAR_OVERRIDES family default, despite E1 measurement proving it works under extended thinking on specific Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive, haiku-4-5 budget 2048)

native_output_with_thinking field is declared on ModelCapabilities but omitted from all three constructor call sites (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path, _intersect_capabilities), causing override rows setting native_output_with_thinking: True to be silently dropped and collapsing to False

Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 are rejected server-side by Converse structured output under thinking (provider rollout gap) and must remain fail-closed; measured haiku and sonnet cells must be enabled via _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES rows scoped to exact measured ids with account/region context
FallbackModel chains must apply conservative all(...) intersection to native_output_with_thinking (identical to every sibling field) so chains mixing measured and unmeasured cells collapse to False

Unit tests must verify both measured cells return NativeOutput under thinking via real read path on object and string-fallback construction paths, opus and unknown Claude ids stay PromptedOutput, and omitting native_output_with_thinking from any constructor site causes tests to fail
